lines.en: Mateo, I have news about the delayed order. The supplier admitted making a mistake with the address yesterday.
lines.pt: Mateo, tenho novidades sobre o pedido atrasado. O fornecedor admitiu ter errado o endereço ontem.

lines.en: Finally! Did he promise to send a new shipment soon? Last time he promised to call, and then he disappeared.
lines.pt: Finalmente! Ele prometeu enviar uma nova remessa logo? Da última vez prometeu ligar, e depois sumiu.

lines.en: He promised to deliver it by Friday, but he denied sending the wrong boxes in the first place.
lines.pt: Ele prometeu entregar até sexta, mas negou ter enviado as caixas erradas desde o início.

lines.en: Typical. I warned our manager that they were unreliable, but nobody listened to me at the time.
lines.pt: Típico. Avisei nossa gerente que eles não eram confiáveis, mas ninguém me ouviu na época.

lines.en: True. A friend of mine advised me to keep every email, so I have proof of the dates and the addresses.
lines.pt: Verdade. Um amigo me aconselhou a guardar todos os e-mails, então tenho prova das datas e dos endereços.

lines.en: Smart. Did the manager say anything about changing suppliers? I have heard rumors about a cheaper company near Seattle.
lines.pt: Esperto. A gerente disse algo sobre trocar de fornecedor? Ouvi rumores de uma empresa mais barata perto de Seattle.

lines.en: She did not say much, but she looked tired. She had been working on the budget since eight this morning.
lines.pt: Ela não disse muito, mas parecia cansada. Estava trabalhando no orçamento desde as oito da manhã.

lines.en: Then let us not bother her today. If the boxes arrive on Friday, we can explain everything on Monday.
lines.pt: Então vamos não incomodá-la hoje. Se as caixas chegarem na sexta, podemos explicar tudo na segunda.

lines.en: Agreed. Still, I will write a short report tonight, in case the supplier changes his story again later.
lines.pt: Combinado. Mesmo assim, vou escrever um relatório curto hoje à noite, caso o fornecedor mude a história de novo.

lines.en: Good idea. Send me a copy, please. I will check the dates and the amounts so nothing is missing.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Mande-me uma cópia, por favor. Vou conferir as datas e os valores para que nada falte.

lines.en: Will do. Thanks for listening, Mateo. Honestly, this week has been so stressful that I almost forgot lunch.
lines.pt: Pode deixar. Obrigada por ouvir, Mateo. Sinceramente, esta semana foi tão estressante que quase esqueci o almoço.

facts.label: Verbos de relato
facts.sub: He promised to help. He admitted making a mistake. He denied sending it. She advised me to wait.

facts.label: prometer + to
facts.sub: Promise é seguido de to + verbo: He promised to deliver it by Friday. They promised to call. Também aceita that: He promised that he would call.

facts.label: -ing
facts.sub: Admit e deny pedem -ing: He admitted making a mistake. He denied sending the wrong boxes. Também aceitam that: He denied that he sent it.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: He admitted making a mistake uses -ing.
He promised making a call is correct.
items.why: Promise is followed by to + verb.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: He admitted making a mistake uses -ing. → Verdadeiro (Admit is followed by -ing.)
He promised making a call is correct. → Falso (Promise is followed by to + verb.)
Deny is followed by -ing. → Verdadeiro (He denied sending it.)

pages.title: Who made the mistake? · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning at an office in Portland. A box of papers sits on the desk. The order from the supplier is late. Elena looks upset and checks her notes. Her colleague Dan listens carefully. They need to know who made the mistake.

“Dan, I have news about the delayed order. The supplier admitted making a mistake with the address yesterday.” says Elena. “Finally! Did he promise to send a new shipment soon? Last time he promised to call, and then he disappeared.” says Dan. “He promised to deliver it by Friday, but he denied sending the wrong boxes in the first place.” says Elena.
